explication: WinUI is the UI layer and control library used by Windows app developers. The principal workflow is an app using WinUI controls and styles to present interactive experiences; this tree shows many domain-specific control implementations, but the excerpts do not establish most runtime wiring between them. The graph therefore groups the major capabilities without implying a control-to-control pipeline. The sampled InkToolbar manager excerpt does show its relationship to InkToolbar. README statements support the app-to-library relationship and product scope.
